nodes.title: Prompt (pose text is added at the end)
widgets_values: <Picture 1> is the character. <Picture 2> is the outfit. <Picture 3> is the pose. Draw the character from <Picture 1> in the pose and camera angle of <Picture 3>; the mannequin is only a pose guide, not an appearance reference. Dress the character in the complete outfit from <Picture 2>, copying every garment, colour and material exactly from that picture. Photorealistic studio photograph, real person, natural skin texture, soft even lighting. Full body from head to toe, plain light grey studio background.

nodes.title: Trigger words (in front of the prompt)
How to use
widgets_values:
## One image per pose (H3 Image)

Draws one character in one outfit, once per picked pose, with MiniMax H3 Image.

**Run:**
1. **Portrait:** pick or upload the character.
2. **Costume:** pick the outfit and its view. Footwear text is added to the prompt when *include_footwear* is on.
3. **Poses:** pick one or more poses. The Pose Picker outputs a list, so every node after it runs once per pose and
   each pose gets its own image. The portrait and the costume are reused for every run.
4. **Size:** pick a chip on the Model Resolution Picker. It sets the output size and the pose mannequin size.
5. Queue.

**Prompt:** the text box holds the main prompt. The footwear text and the pose text (`pose_prompts_en` for the same
pose) are added to its end.

**Settings** (from the source): euler / simple, 6 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed, seed 42 fixed. VRAM is purged after
the text encoder and before VAE decode.

**LoRAs:** add H3 Image LoRAs in *LoRAs (H3 Image)*. It is empty by default. Their trigger words appear in *Trigger
words* and go in front of the prompt; untick any you do not want.

**Custom nodes:** ComfyUI-KikoCharSheet, LoRA Manager, KikoTools, KJNodes, rgthree-comfy.

**First run: download the models.** In *Toggle stages*, turn on **Download models** and queue once; files you already have are skipped without going online. Then turn it off again. Civitai models and gated Hugging Face models need a token, set where ComfyUI starts (never in the workflow, which would share it):

Linux / macOS (`~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc` or your start script):
```
export CIVITAI_API_KEY="your-civitai-key"
export HF_TOKEN="hf_your-token"
```
Windows (Command Prompt once, then a new window):
```
setx CIVITAI_API_KEY "your-civitai-key"
setx HF_TOKEN "hf_your-token"
```
Portable build: add `set CIVITAI_API_KEY=...` and `set HF_TOKEN=...` above the `python` line in `run_nvidia_gpu.bat`. Restart ComfyUI after setting them. Keys: civitai.com → Account settings → API Keys; huggingface.co → Settings → Access Tokens.
